correctness.rationale: The normalized incidence backtracking exhausts 176 point-labelled completions and checks every one is incidence-isomorphic to exactly one representative distinguished by its noncollinearity-cycle pattern. The explicit 512-entry point/line majority lookup tables verify H^3=H^2, K^3=K^2, the inverse-bijection of recurrent phases, matching paired fiber weights, and sharp stabilization witnesses. Algebraic factorization of F^4 into independent shore projections then proves fixed-state and temporal two-cycle basin sizes for all 2^18 configurations per graph. Separate C++ full functional-graph enumeration over 786432 states agrees with each claimed population, entry cutoff, and individual basin spectrum. No logarithmic, asymptotic, or infinite-family inference is drawn from sampling.

value.rationale: The three (9_3) configurations form the complete and historically motivated smallest geometrically realizable symmetric cubic incidence class; not an arbitrarily parameter-sliced family. The result is a complete dynamical classification, including exact fiber distributions and every individual basin, and exhibits a sharp Pappus versus non-Pappus stabilization distinction plus absence versus presence of singleton fixed basins. These specific invariants are motivated by geometry-to-dynamics comparison and give a reusable benchmark beyond general eventual-period-two theory. No general or downstream theorem is needed for the complete-class finite result to be mathematically informative.
